description: This file implements OCR transformation logic for Vertex AI using Mistral OCR API format, including configuration, environment validation, URL-to-base64 conversion (sync and async), and request transformation.

classes.name: VertexAIOCRConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Vertex AI OCR transformation, inheriting from MistralOCRConfig, handling environment validation, URL conversion, and request transformation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the VertexAIOCRConfig instance, setting up the base class and VertexBase.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates environment and prepares headers with Bearer token for Vertex AI OCR.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API endpoint URL for Vertex AI OCR based on project and location parameters.

methods.name: _convert_url_to_data_uri_sync
methods.description: Synchronously converts a URL to a base64 data URI using convert_url_to_base64.

methods.name: _convert_url_to_data_uri_async
methods.description: Asynchronously converts a URL to a base64 data URI using async_convert_url_to_base64.

methods.name: transform_ocr_request
methods.description: Transforms OCR request data, converting URLs to base64 data URIs synchronously.

methods.name: async_transform_ocr_request
methods.description: Transforms OCR request data, converting URLs to base64 data URIs asynchronously.
